Class WhoRelyingPartyOperations

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.passkey.WhoRelyingPartyOperations
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.WebAuthnRelyingPartyOperations
public class WhoRelyingPartyOperations extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.WebAuthnRelyingPartyOperations
who's relying party: Spring's Webauthn4JRelyingPartyOperations, configured from PasskeySettings, with three changes.
  • Registration and sign-in require user verification; registration requires a resident key. Spring enforces both from the options it stored in the session, so a client cannot downgrade them.
  • Creation options first create who's user entity for the identity (a 64-byte user handle), so Spring never creates its own, and name it with the PasskeyNameResolver. The name is refreshed on every creation-options call, so an identity that gains or changes an address gets it on its next registration. Devices keep the name they stored.
  • A registration is refused unless the creation options in the session belong to the identity signed in now. Spring takes the owner from the stored options alone, so options left in a session by one identity could otherwise register a passkey for it after another identity signs in on the same session.
  • A successful registration is reported to the PasskeyAddedNotifier.
